python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
c = conn.cursor()

# Test yield_2024 SQL
sql = '''
SELECT ROUND(SUM(tr.amount) / SUM(op.amount) * 100.0, 6) AS yield_pct
FROM revenues tr
JOIN operating_metrics op ON tr.period_end = op.period_end AND tr.months = op.months
WHERE tr.category = 'Transaction revenues'
  AND op.metric = 'Total payment volume'
  AND tr.section_id = 'c01:s01'
  AND op.section_id = 'c01:s03'
  AND tr.period_end = '2024-12-31'
'''
c.execute(sql)
print('yield_2024:', c.fetchone())

# Test yield_2023 SQL
sql2 = '''
SELECT ROUND(SUM(tr.amount) / SUM(op.amount) * 100.0, 6) AS yield_pct
FROM revenues tr
JOIN operating_metrics op ON tr.period_end = op.period_end AND tr.months = op.months
WHERE tr.category = 'Transaction revenues'
  AND op.metric = 'Total payment volume'
  AND tr.section_id = 'c01:s01'
  AND op.section_id = 'c01:s03'
  AND tr.period_end = '2023-12-31'
'''
c.execute(sql2)
print('yield_2023:', c.fetchone())

# Test yield_change SQL
sql3 = '''
SELECT ROUND((
  (SELECT SUM(t.amount) / SUM(o.amount) * 100.0
   FROM revenues t JOIN operating_metrics o ON t.period_end = o.period_end AND t.months = o.months
   WHERE t.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume'
     AND t.section_id = 'c01:s01' AND o.section_id = 'c01:s03' AND t.period_end = '2024-12-31')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(t.amount) / SUM(o.amount) * 100.0
   FROM revenues t JOIN operating_metrics o ON t.period_end = o.period_end AND t.months = o.months
   WHERE t.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume'
     AND t.section_id = 'c01:s01' AND o.section_id = 'c01:s03' AND t.period_end = '2023-12-31')
) * 100.0, 6) AS yield_change_bps
'''
c.execute(sql3)
print('yield_change_bps:', c.fetchone())

# Test transaction_contribution SQL
sql4 = '''
SELECT ROUND(
  ((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND t.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND t.section_id = 'c01:s01')
   - (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND t.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND t.section_id = 'c01:s01'))
  /
  ((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = 'Total net revenues (2)' AND t.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND t.section_id = 'c01:s01')
   - (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = 'Total net revenues (2)' AND t.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND t.section_id = 'c01:s01'))
  * 100.0, 6) AS txn_contribution_pct
'''
c.execute(sql4)
print('txn_contribution:', c.fetchone())
"

python3 -c "
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
c = conn.cursor()

# Replay all SQL queries
queries = {
    'yield_2024': 'SELECT ROUND(SUM(tr.amount) / SUM(op.amount) * 100.0, 6) AS yield_pct FROM revenues tr JOIN operating_metrics op ON tr.period_end = op.period_end AND tr.months = op.months WHERE tr.category = \"Transaction revenues\" AND op.metric = \"Total payment volume\" AND tr.section_id = \"c01:s01\" AND op.section_id = \"c01:s03\" AND tr.period_end = \"2024-12-31\"',
    'yield_2023': 'SELECT ROUND(SUM(tr.amount) / SUM(op.amount) * 100.0, 6) AS yield_pct FROM revenues tr JOIN operating_metrics op ON tr.period_end = op.period_end AND tr.months = op.months WHERE tr.category = \"Transaction revenues\" AND op.metric = \"Total payment volume\" AND tr.section_id = \"c01:s01\" AND op.section_id = \"c01:s03\" AND tr.period_end = \"2023-12-31\"',
    'yield_change': 'SELECT ROUND((\n  (SELECT SUM(t.amount) / SUM(o.amount) * 100.0\n   FROM revenues t JOIN operating_metrics o ON t.period_end = o.period_end AND t.months = o.months\n   WHERE t.category = \"Transaction revenues\" AND o.metric = \"Total payment volume\"\n     AND t.section_id = \"c01:s01\" AND o.section_id = \"c01:s03\" AND t.period_end = \"2024-12-31\")\n  -\n  (SELECT SUM(t.amount) / SUM(o.amount) * 100.0\n   FROM revenues t JOIN operating_metrics o ON t.period_end = o.period_end AND t.months = o.months\n   WHERE t.category = \"Transaction revenues\" AND o.metric = \"Total payment volume\"\n     AND t.section_id = \"c01:s01\" AND o.section_id = \"c01:s03\" AND t.period_end = \"2023-12-31\")\n) * 100.0, 6) AS yield_change_bps',
    'transaction_contribution': 'SELECT ROUND(\n  ((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = \"Transaction revenues\" AND t.period_end = \"2024-12-31\" AND t.section_id = \"c01:s01\")\n   - (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = \"Transaction revenues\" AND t.period_end = \"2023-12-31\" AND t.section_id = \"c01:s01\"))\n  /\n  ((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = \"Total net revenues (2)\" AND t.period_end = \"2024-12-31\" AND t.section_id = \"c01:s01\")\n   - (SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM revenues t WHERE t.category = \"Total net revenues (2)\" AND t.period_end = \"2023-12-31\" AND t.section_id = \"c01:s01\"))\n  * 100.0, 6) AS txn_contribution_pct'
}

# Load the answer file
with open('/logs/artifacts/answer.json') as f:
    answer = json.load(f)

tolerance = 0.000001
for ans in answer['answers']:
    c.execute(ans['sql'])
    computed = c.fetchone()[0]
    expected = ans['value']
    diff = abs(computed - expected)
    status = 'OK' if diff < tolerance else f'MISMATCH (diff={diff})'
    print(f'{ans[\"id\"]}: computed={computed}, expected={expected}, {status}')

print()
print(f'Conclusion verdict: {answer[\"conclusion\"][\"verdict\"]}')
print(f'Total net revenue increase: 31,797 - 29,771 = 2,026 (USDM)')
print(f'Transaction revenue increase: 28,842 - 26,857 = 1,985 (USDM)')
print(f'Yield 2023: 1.756991% > Yield 2024: 1.715611% -> yield DECREASED, not increased')
print(f'Transaction contribution: 97.98% of total rev increase, but yield dropped')
print('Net revenue growth driven by TPV volume growth (10%), not by yield improvement')
"
